rejected.detail: CORRECT PRODUCT: `Palexia® IR tapentadol 50 mg`, 20 film-coated tablets, single carton flat-on at 2973x1361, fully legible, yellow chevrons and a blue rule. Rejected on market: 'AUST R 165310' and the Seqirus distributor mark are Australian. Worth re-finding as the Grünenthal EU pack.
